tools.name: search_design_styles
tools.description: Browse House AI's interior design, exterior and landscaping styles (Japandi, Scandinavian, mid-century modern, coastal, farmhouse, industrial and more). Use it when someone is deciding how to redecorate, remodel or restyle a room, a house front or a yard, or wants style ideas. Returns style names wi

tools.name: get_design_style
tools.description: Details for one House AI design style: its color palette, materials, furniture, textiles, lighting, decor and what to avoid. Use it to explain a style (for example 'what is Japandi?') or to plan a room makeover before redesigning.

tools.name: get_house_ai_app_link
tools.description: A link to download the House AI interior design app for iPhone and Android, where the user's designs are saved and they can keep editing rooms, shop the look and try more styles.

tools.name: get_photo_upload_link
tools.description: Make a private link where the user can upload a photo of their room, house or yard from their phone or computer. Use it when the user wants a redesign but hasn't attached a photo and this app can't pass attached photos to tools. After they say it's uploaded, pass the upload_id to the redesign tool.

tools.name: redesign_room
tools.description: AI interior design: redesign, redecorate or remodel a room from a photo of it, in a chosen style (for example a Japandi living room, a modern farmhouse kitchen or a cozy bedroom makeover). Keeps the room's layout and returns a photorealistic image of the new design. Uses one House AI design credit.

tools.name: redesign_exterior
tools.description: AI exterior design and landscaping: restyle the outside of a house or building for curb appeal (siding, paint, trim, roof color, front door) or redesign a yard, patio or garden, from a photo. Returns a photorealistic image of the new design. Uses one House AI design credit.

tools.name: paint_walls
tools.description: Repaint the walls in a photo of a room or house with a new paint color, to preview a color before painting (for example 'sage green', 'warm white with black trim'). Uses one House AI design credit.

tools.name: change_flooring
tools.description: Replace the floor in a room photo with new flooring, to preview a renovation (for example 'light oak hardwood', 'large gray porcelain tile', 'herringbone'). Uses one House AI design credit.

tools.name: empty_room
tools.description: Remove the furniture and clutter from a room photo to see the empty space, for decluttering, moving or planning a new layout. Uses one House AI design credit.

tools.name: furnish_empty_room
tools.description: Virtual staging: furnish and decorate an empty or bare room from a photo in a chosen style, for a new home, a rental or a listing. Uses one House AI design credit.

tools.name: find_furniture_and_decor
tools.description: Search House AI's shop for real furniture and home decor you can buy, like sofas, rugs, lamps, coffee tables, beds or wall art, optionally under a budget. Returns products with prices, sellers and links.

tools.name: shop_this_look
tools.description: Find real products that match an item in a room photo or a House AI design, for example the sofa, rug or pendant light in a redesign. Pass the design's image_url and the item to find.

tools.name: list_my_designs
tools.description: The user's recent House AI designs (room redesigns, exteriors, paint and flooring previews), newest first, with image links.

tools.name: get_my_credits
tools.description: How many House AI designs the user can still make today or this plan period.
